name: PHIL 2210W
title: Metaphysics
description: Fundamental questions about the nature of things. Topics may include universals and particulars, parts and wholes, space and time, possibility and necessity, persistence and change, causation, persons, free will.
requirement_description: One three-credit course in Philosophy at the 1100 level; ENGL 1007 or 1010 or 1011.
